newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen opening higher after GDP.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen opening higher after GDP.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to open higher on Wednesday after news of slower growth in third-quarter preliminary gross domestic product strengthened bonds, analysts said.
Bonds initially weakened on the data which showed the GDP had risen 2.2 percent, above the forecast 1.8 percent, but well below the previous quarter's 4.7 percent increase.

"Even though the data missed the forecast number, 2.2 is still less than 4.7 and it confirms a decelerating economic trend," said Phil Orlando, chief investment officer of Value Line's Asset Management division, adding that some of the increase was due to inventory rebuilding.
The Dow Jones industrial average rose 34.29 points to 6,007.02 on Tuesday.
